initialPr50.originalBody:
PR #38's historical layout milestone does not establish responsive Continuous preview or a safe integration into current develop. This documentation-only assessment recommends **ARCHIVE / HOLD**: preserve #38 OPEN/DRAFT/PAUSED and do not fund a migration or another broad implementation round now.

The study reconciles merged #36/#37 and accepted #48/#49, inventories all 341 historical paths, audits the two distinct acceptance contracts and compares three investment options. It independently matches 292 measurement rows to retained originals and verifies 4,136 archived members; 864 omitted members remain explicitly uninspected. The original stock **250 ms objective is INCOMPLETE** and strict v2 **Input remains FAIL**, including 148.88 ms paragraph selection, 228.87/192.51 ms appearance and 454.69/6,190.40 ms media Save/Cancel.

### Review material

- [Decision report](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/blob/24616837b5289299466cf64e37952d61bc95df6b/docs/native/continuous-architecture-feasibility-2026-10.md)
- [Audit and reproduction notes](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/blob/24616837b5289299466cf64e37952d61bc95df6b/docs/native/evidence/continuous-feasibility-2026-10/README.md)
- [Non-executable evidence/decision manifest](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/blob/24616837b5289299466cf64e37952d61bc95df6b/docs/native/evidence/continuous-feasibility-2026-10/evidence-index.json)

### Immutable delivery receipt

| Role | Commit | Tree |
|---|---|---|
| Report | `24616837b5289299466cf64e37952d61bc95df6b` | `b8d56f4c53a52c974d6a78cfd5f79d099ff87d3f` |
| Accepted develop / sole parent | `0df86ad2bdae005d49be68096c2f784b49de8109` | `05d534030761a7b68a8579bb33e4dfb50161ce90` |
| Untouched experimental #38 | `31fa3ad12f3e0c87f5e45cea6f97801af53b67cb` | `6da0d065d4c76dab2102ef9411761890c2da2441` |

Exactly three new documentation/JSON files; no product, script, workflow, dependency, test, gate or historical evidence changes. Live recheck at 2026-10-26T18:13:18Z still matched these pins and confirmed the report PR's exact head and three-file scope. #38 remains open, draft and unmerged; #36/#37/#48/#49 remain merged.

### Validation

- PASS: local `npm run test:static`, structured arithmetic/JSON and relative-link checks, all 48 reference definitions/source anchors, three-file staged scope and `git diff --check`.
- URLs: 40 direct HTTP 200; eight initial HTTP 504 responses verified via connected GitHub reads (seven immutable blobs and one run/jobs). No unseen archive download is claimed.
- Exact-head hosted validation is **PENDING at 2026-10-26T18:13:18Z**: [Native 40375067926](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/actions/runs/40375067926) and [Web 40375076102](https://github.com/DouglasNLima/local-docs-studio/actions/runs/40375076102), both attempt 1, `workflow_dispatch`, head `24616837b5289299466cf64e37952d61bc95df6b`. Neither has a final conclusion. Native job `121755784939` and Edge/Chromium jobs `121755806290`/`121755806585` remain in progress; the original .853 replay job `121755787598` is actually SKIPPED. Downstream jobs, including the Pages deployment condition, are not yet reported as completed/skipped. No full-suite success is claimed.
- `[skip ci]` prevents broad automatic PR workflows from restarting the paused controlled-performance study. Unchanged `native.yml` and `pages.yml` are explicitly dispatched at this exact head. No failed required check is waived, renamed or rerun to green; other suites and fresh performance diagnostics are NOT RUN.
- No Pages deployment on this assessment branch. Existing hosted validation may exercise unchanged disposable test-certificate/package lifecycle checks; no product release or production signing.

### Decision boundaries

**250 ms: INCOMPLETE. Strict v2 Input: FAIL. Integration into normal shipping product: NO-GO.** Current accepted stock correctness and prior tested-host portable acceptance remain separate facts; beta/public production approval is not granted.

No merge, Ready transition, experiment integration, PR38 source/base/title/status change, release/tag/updater, production signing or personal-host GUI/installation mutation. A future paragraph-selection attribution control is described only as an optional reopening proof if owner priorities change; it is not started or funded here.

The decision study is published; hosted CI remains pending as explicitly permitted by the Goal X brief. This is not a final green CI receipt or permission to merge. The optional cross-link comment on #38 is deferred while hosted validation remains pending; #38 has not been edited.
